name: Last Seats in the Lagoon
description: Several rigid lifeboats occupy a tiled lagoon among stranded passengers, with seats and rope sides shown on each boat.
natural_language: Move the lifeboats to rescue every passenger. Boats move forward, backward, or sideways one square at a time, but never turn or move diagonally. Passengers beside a roped side board automatically when a seat is free, so plan the order and capacity consequences before certifying the rescue.

metadata.notes: Original 2D lifeboat bridge grounded in TRP-701's orthogonal non-rotating boats, rope-side compulsory pickups, and exact all-passengers-seated outcome. Human and agent calibration are pending.
